documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand across key markets, improved realizations, and stable raw material environments. Management noted robust demand from export markets like China and Bangladesh, alongside ongoing capacity expansion at their 150,000 spindle greenfield project in Odisha. The company remains optimistic about medium to long-term industry outlooks, supported by operational efficiencies, favorable trade developments, and new sustainability initiatives. Furthermore, management expects stable margins and significant incremental revenue contributions from the new Odisha plant as it moves toward commercial production. Sportking India Limited reported its operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with revenue from operations reaching Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores from the new capacity in the remaining period of the financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores coming off the capacity in the time left in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects margins in the Odisha unit to be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% higher than baseline operations once operational.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: Management guides that margins for the second half are expected to be close to what was achieved in the first half of the year.
guidance.quote: So whatever we are doing with our old capacity, we expect to be there or thereabouts in the second half also.

guidance.claim: The company expects the peak long-term debt to be around INR750 crores or less by March '27.
guidance.quote: So, by March '27, we expect our peak debt to be -- the long-term debt to be, you can say, around INR750 crores, maybe less, about INR700 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to reach approximately INR 3,000 crores in FY27 and exceed INR 4,000 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores. So that's what 20% up. And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets 15% long-term EBITDA margins post-Odisha plant commissioning.
guidance.quote: But otherwise, we expect the long-term margins to stay after our Odisha plant around 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from our export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has visibility for yarn demand until March 10th and it remains strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good. The demand is the same or even better than what it was.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: The company anticipates the current quarter to be similar or better than the previous quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: But yes, the current quarter looks to be similar or even better than what we have delivered this last quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule with building construction almost complete.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front are 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule. Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the building construction is now almost complete.

capex_expansion.claim: The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.
capex_expansion.quote: The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure for the Odisha greenfield expansion is INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So the company has announced the INR1,000 crores Greenfield expansion in Odisha involving 1.5 lakh splindles.

capex_expansion.claim: Proposed capex programme takes 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield project in Odisha is expected to commence production in Q3 FY27 and be completed within the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects the Odisha plant to reach 90% capacity utilization by the end of March.
capex_expansion.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

margins_costs.claim: The successful commissioning of the solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%. Thereby enhancing our overall cost competitiveness.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation run rate is expected to be around INR17 crores from the next quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant is expected to provide EBITDA margins 300 to 400 basis points higher than existing plants.
margins_costs.quote: So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing facilities are operating at near full capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: With our existing facilities operating at near full capacity and market demand growing stronger, this new capacity will provide the necessary headroom to scale our operations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The Odisha project includes a 30% capital subsidy paid in 5 equal installments, returning about INR200 to INR220 crores over 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: First is the capital subsidy, which we are going to get for 30% capital subsidy, which will be paid to us in 5 equal installments. On a INR1,000 crores investment, we are looking at about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back to us in 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed merger will be funded predominantly through preferential shares with a cash outflow of less than INR 25-30 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So the merger will be predominantly preferential shares. So there will be a small outflow of cash. I think it will be less than maybe around INR25 crores, INR30 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to unforeseen risks and uncertainties and are not a guarantee of future performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are not a guarantee of future performance and will involve unforeseen risks and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is currently dealing with a cotton import duty that is in effect until October 31st.
risks_headwinds.quote: So right now, this import duty is the resumption is still 31st October.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production at the Odisha greenfield project is intended to start within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company works on a window of 80 to 90 days for order visibility and sales.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, of course. See, we generally work on a window of 80 to 90 days, so we are sold in January and many days.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to work on making the fabric and garment companies compliant to merge within the next couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So I think within next couple of months we intend to -- I think this will happen.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to finish the Odisha greenfield project within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach 96% to 97% utilization of the new capacity by the start of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
